Hi all — looping in tax-ops notes from my quick triage:

- Checksum mismatches are commonly caused by leading zeros dropped or non-US formatting on the vendor side. Carlos, when you send the bank letter can you confirm the TIN exactly as it appears on the institution letterhead (no spaces/dashes)?
- If the bank letter matches but the checksum still fails, tax-ops will accept a signed notarized affidavit plus the bank letter as supplemental evidence and I'll flag the PO for manual override.
- For overrides we require (a) bank letter or payroll confirmation, (b) delegation affidavit (you provided), and (c) matching legal entity name on the W-8BEN-E.

Carlos — happy to start the manual review now if you want us to; otherwise attach the bank letter here when available.
